question: A solid hemisphere is drilled with a cylindrical with radius (R)/(2) hole through its center. If the height of the removed cylinder equals the hemisphere's radius R, find the ratio of the volume removed to the volume remaining.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of Hemisphere = 2/3 π R³

Volume of Cylinder removed = π (R/2)² × R = 1/4 π R³

Volume Remaining = (2/3 − 1/4) π R³ = 5/12 π R³

Ratio = 1/4 : 5/12 ⇒ 3 : 5

**∴ The correct option is (4).**
